# order

A service generated by api-factory. The designer writes `design/<domain>/` and `db/schema/*.sql`; everything
else (`specs/`, `proto/`, `db/queries/`, `gen/`, `internal/handler/`, `cmd/server/wiring_gen.go`) is generated:

```sh
factory --project . design    # design/ → proto + specs
factory --project . check
factory --project . prepare   # → generated code
go mod tidy && go build ./...
```

## Environment

What the service reads at start-up (`runtime/server`). The image already sets `PORT`, `METRICS_PORT`, `SERVICE_NAME` and `APP_VERSION`; the deployment provides the rest.

| Variable | This service | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | **required** | — | Postgres connection string (the service's own database) |
| `AUTH_MODE` | **required** | — | `token` (Bearer token checked by the server) or `none` (the platform authenticates) |
| `AUTH_TOKEN_SHA256` | optional | — | with AUTH_MODE=token (then required): SHA-256 hex of each accepted token, comma separated |
| `AMQP_URL` | **required** (sends / handles messages, state machine timeouts) | — | RabbitMQ connection string with the environment's vhost. Without it the outbox is written but never sent, no handler consumes and no state machine times out (a WARN at start-up) |
| `PORT` | optional | `8080` | the API and the probes /livez /readyz /healthz |
| `METRICS_PORT` | optional | — | /metrics without authentication on this port (the image sets 9090) |
| `SERVICE_NAME` | optional | `api-factory-service` | the RabbitMQ connection name (the image sets it to the service's name) |
| `PAGE_TOKEN_KEY` | optional | — | key that signs page tokens; without it a random key per process (tokens break across restarts and instances; a WARN) |
| `FACTORY_SHARDS` | optional | — | shard routing for sharded tables, e.g. `1-2=postgres://…;*=postgres://…` (empty = everything in DATABASE_URL) |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` | optional | `3000` | per-request timeout |
| `SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS` | optional | `15000` | graceful shutdown limit for HTTP and for the background workers (each); keep it ≥ the message transaction timeout (10s) |
| `APP_VERSION` | optional | `dev` | returned in /healthz as X-App-Version (the image sets it from the build arg VERSION) |

Test environments only (never set them in production):

- `INSTANCE_ID`: echoed by /healthz (tests: which process answered)
- `FACTORY_TEST_CLOCK`: `1`: the request header X-Factory-Now sets now(); state machine timeouts are driven by the test entry
- `FACTORY_TEST_FAULTS`: `1`: fault injection headers and the in-process message test entry are honoured
- `FACTORY_TEST_RELAY_CRASH`: with FACTORY_TEST_FAULTS=1: the relay exits at a crash point (crash tests)
<!-- factory:env:end -->
